headline: Their top complaint is customer support, not the app.
comparison_note: These tiles show October 2026 only. For comparison, the September 2026 report had an average of 3.91 stars across 19,743 reviews; October 2026 averaged [[kpis.avg_rating#0|dec2]].
release_note: No October release stands out. The main versions all sit close to the month average. Reviews with no app version are the outlier, and are worth a look with the app team.

actions.title: Add a human agent route. Target: bot complaints from 94 to under 50
actions.text: Support is in [[complaints.share@code=support|pct]] of written complaints, ahead of late delivery. [[kpis.support_bot_mentions#0|int]] of those name the chatbot, AI or a human agent. Offer a human route when the bot cannot solve the issue. The target halves that count.
actions.measure: support complaints that also mention bot, chatbot, AI, human, real person or live agent

actions.title: Pull dinner-peak late deliveries by order hour. Target: night gap from 0.18 to under 0.10
actions.text: Reviews written from 8 pm to midnight, the stretch with the most reviews per hour, average [[windows.avg_rating@window=night|dec2]] against [[windows.avg_rating@window=afternoon|dec2]] from noon to 8 pm. The hour is when the review was written, not when the order arrived, so first pull late-delivery share by order hour, then check rider supply and delivery-time promises at dinner.
actions.measure: rating gap between reviews written 8 pm to midnight and noon to 8 pm, and late-delivery share by order hour

actions.title: Reply to every 1-star. Target: from 49% to 80% replied
actions.text: From 07-10-2026 to 31-10-2026, when regular replies were in place, [[kpis.one_star_reply_rate_since_replies_steady#0|pct]] of 1-star reviews got a reply and [[kpis.one_star_unreplied_since_replies_steady#0|int]] did not, about [[kpis.one_star_unreplied_per_day_since_replies_steady#0|int]] a day. Decide whether to add staff or automate a reply that names the issue. Across the whole month the rate is [[kpis.one_star_reply_rate#0|pct]].
actions.measure: share of 1-star reviews with a reply, counted from the day regular replies started (07-10-2026 in October)
